intro.title: refav1 re-read: the arm that TURNS tracks the road WORSE than a straight line
lines: The same moment of the same drive, planned THREE ways. One checkpoint (step 21,109), one world model, one set of decision heads - the arms differ ONLY in what the planner's cost charges for. MEASURED over n = 40 windows / 8 episodes, tier T1 (self-action open loop).
THIS CUT CORRECTS ITS OWN PREDECESSOR, AND THE CORRECTION IS THE FLOOR

The first cut called ccos_argmax 'the arm that TURNS' and wk15 'accurate because it does not turn'. Both readings came through a turn-recall gate |dyaw| > 0.15 rad - and THE HUMAN'S OWN RECORDED DRIVING FAILS THAT GATE, passing 3 of 9 turn windows (median dyaw 0.0431) while ccos_argmax passes 6 of 9, TWICE AS OFTEN AS THE HUMAN. A gate the ground truth fails is not measuring skill; it is measuring the gate.
Re-read on curvature MAE - a metric the human passes BY CONSTRUCTION - against a floor that makes the sentence checkable: a PERFECTLY STRAIGHT plan. The answer INVERTS.
GREEN    the GROUND TRUTH - what the human actually drove.

WHITE    ha0, THE STRAIGHT FLOOR - a plan that never steers (a = 0, kappa = 0 at the measured v0; MEASURED max |y| 0.000000 m over all 40 windows). Drawn WIDE and UNDERNEATH, because it is the bar this reel's central claim is measured against.

grey     ha0_ext, the ECHO control - holds the MEASURED (a0, kappa0). It is an ADE floor and NOT a road-tracking floor: curvature MAE 0.077298, and it leaves the mu = 0.7 friction circle on 18.5 % of the 27 windows at v0 >= 2 m/s.
MAGENTA  ccos_argmax - no curvature charge at all (W_KAPPA 0).
ORANGE   wk15 - a curvature CHARGE in the cost (W_KAPPA 15.11).
VIOLET   best - that charge AND the mu = 0.7 friction-circle cap.
THE RANKING ON THE REACHABLE METRIC - curvature MAE 1/m, pooled over valid steps by taniteval.four_families, n = 40 windows / 8 episodes
wk15         0.030982   the best lateral tracking in the programme - 23 % BETTER than a perfectly straight plan   (n_steps 271)
ha0          0.040083   <-- THE STRAIGHT FLOOR, the bar   (n_steps 289)
ccos_argmax  0.055369   WORSE THAN DRIVING IN A STRAIGHT LINE   (n_steps 289)

WHAT TO WATCH FOR: where the road does not bend, the magenta line swings out of the lane while the orange and violet ones lie on the white straight floor - and so does the green ground truth. The failure is MAGNITUDE, never direction: 153 of 153 retained plans across the 2x2 curve the way their goal asked.
OPEN LOOP throughout (PI ruling 2026-09-02): the model controls nothing and the ego data keeps arriving from the recording. Every line is READ from a banked dump - no model runs in this renderer.

outro.title: What the reel showed
lines: 1. THE UNPENALISED ARM DOES NOT TRACK THE ROAD - IT OVER-TURNS. ccos_argmax reads curvature MAE 0.055369 against the straight floor's 0.040083, i.e. worse than a plan that never steers, and it leaves the mu = 0.7 friction circle on 29.6 % of the 27 feasibility windows, peaking at 3.262 g. The old turn-recall gate rewarded it for exactly that.

2. THERE IS AN ARM THAT BOTH DRIVES ACCURATELY AND TRACKS THE ROAD: wk15, at ADE 0.8934 m and curvature MAE 0.030982 - 23 % better than the straight floor. The W_KAPPA sweep has a CLEAN INTERIOR OPTIMUM near 15: 0.05537 (0) -> 0.03941 (1) -> 0.03874 (3) -> 0.03352 (7) -> 0.03098 (15.11) -> 0.03802 (151). Not a saturating knob and not a cliff.

3. AND ITS CAPPED SIBLING IS SAFE, REPLICATED. best (wk15 + the mu = 0.7 cap) carries the programme's only REPLICATED, NON-VACUOUS zero friction-circle violation rate: kamm_over 0.0000 at BOTH inference seeds, max|kappa| 0.0800 at both, peak 0.332 g - 89 % of the human's own peak lateral load of 0.373. It is not a stopped arm buying safety by declining to act.

4. THE SIGN IS NEVER WRONG; THE FAILURE IS MAGNITUDE. 153 of 153 retained plans across the 2x2 (W_KAPPA in {0, 15.11} x seed in {0, 1}) curve the way their goal asked. W_KAPPA reduces turn MAGNITUDE, never direction - and the |dyaw| > 0.15 gate reads reduced magnitude as 'zero turns'.

5. WHAT IS NOT FIXED: THE LONGITUDINAL FAMILY. The echo floor ha0_ext still beats every arm on ADE (0.8772 m against best's 0.8838 m) - while itself sitting outside the friction circle on 18.5 % of windows, so that comparison only means anything with its feasibility rate beside it. Lateral and safety are established; longitudinal is the open blocker.
THE WORLD MODEL - AND THIS PART IS WORKING

Over all 40 windows the predictor beats the persistence control on 28 of its 30 steps: it LOSES by 0.0809 at 0.2 s and WINS by 0.3168 at 6.0 s. The defect this reel shows is in the PLANNER's cost geometry, not in the model's ability to predict the world.
THE TWO CONTROLS THAT LICENSE EVERY FRAME

(a) THE INTEGRATOR. The recorded actions, integrated through the SAME unicycle every arm was rolled through, land on the dumped ground truth to 0.1552 m mean (median 0.1512, max 0.2981) over the 27 admissible windows at v0 >= 2 m/s - while the same actions read under the legacy KAPPA unit miss by 0.8727 m, a 5.62x separation. BOTH halves are required: a passing arm alone cannot tell a right integrator from a loose tolerance. See _GT_CONTROL.png beside this file.

(b) THE CURVATURE. Every curvature number on every frame is computed by taniteval.four_families - the eval's own function - and the render REFUSES unless the panel aggregate reproduces the banked table exactly: ha0 0.040083, wk15 0.030982, best 0.031281, ccos_argmax 0.055369, ha0_ext 0.077298. All five reproduce.

MEASURED 2026-09-05/06 from .../2026-09-05-refav1-cost-geometry/raw/arms/. Tier T1. n = 40 windows / 8 episode clusters - a PICTURE OF A BANKED PANEL, not a new result: no interval is computed here and none is claimed. The 3-of-9 human turn-gate figure and the 153/153 sign control come from the stratified turn panel (M74 / M75), NOT from these 40 windows.
